item.tib: byams ma sngags lugs la nye bar mkho ba'i shog chung
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang tshogs brgya so sor 'bul lugs yan mkhar snar brtsams pa byas kyang / mjug lus pa rang gi gcung po sngags bla khro rgyal bkra shis dang / 'dul bla rnam rgyal tshul khrims zur gyi bskur (zung gis bskul) ngor/ bru ston gong ma'i gdan sa rnam thos dbal gyi bsgrub (sgrub) gnas su sman ri'i mkhan zur nyi ming pas sbyar ba dge legs gyur cig/
